environmentVariables.name: LITHTRIX_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Your Lithtrix API key (ltx_...). Register free at https://lithtrix.ai/v1/register — Spark trial included, no card required. Or use the lithtrix_register tool.

environmentVariables.name: LITHTRIX_PASSPORT_MASTER_SEED
environmentVariables.description: Optional. UTF-8 passphrase for lithtrix_passport_derive and lithtrix_delegate signing — never sent to the Lithtrix API.

environmentVariables.name: LITHTRIX_PASSPORT_PRIVATE_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Optional. PKCS#8 PEM Ed25519 private key for lithtrix_delegate signing (client-side only).

environmentVariables.name: LITHTRIX_API_URL
environmentVariables.description: Optional. Override the Lithtrix API base URL. Defaults to https://api.lithtrix.ai.
